title: Weight painting
summary: Fixing the automatic weights, painting from the root up with masks: the head's vertices fully to the head bone, the pelvis fully to the hips (root) so it no longer drags with the thigh, the chest to the chest bone; auto normalize takes the weight away from the other bones.
expected_result: The same pose, cleaner: the head and pelvis move rigidly with their bones, no stretching around the hips.

steps.note: edit mode: the head's vertices (a mask for painting)
paint the head fully to the head bone (the gradient trick, auto normalize: nothing else pulls it)
the root bone takes the pelvis fully: it no longer drags when a thigh moves
